children: Custom Health engaged Yorkville Ives for a 12-month U.S. capital-markets advisory term and amended its note to up to US$15.0M, with 17% annual interest payable monthly in cash. Q3 2026 revenue was US$14.4M, up 220% year over year.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Note bears 17% annual interest, payable monthly
The amended borrowing cost is substantial and adds recurring cash interest obligations.
Note principal up to US$15.0M; US$3.0M funded
Additional tranches require mutual written agreement; the release does not establish that more funds will be drawn.
Repayment-on-offering obligation removed
The company can retain the previously funded proceeds for operations and other corporate purposes rather than repay upon the offering.
Exit fee fixed at US$150K
The fee is due by March 31, 2027, or upon full repayment if earlier; early repayment is permitted without additional penalty.
Q3 revenue US$14.4M, up 220% year over year
Rapid growth provides operating context, but the release attributes growth partly to recent acquisitions and gives no comparable prior-period revenue figure.
Yorkville Ives engaged for an initial 12 months
The engagement supports exploration of U.S. capital markets, but includes no commitment to arrange or provide financing.
